name: Goldener Löwe
beschreibung:
Set on Kufstein's Unterer Stadtplatz, the historic Goldener Loewen welcomes visitors with well-appointed rooms and authentic Tyrolean inn gastronomy. It serves as an ideal base for city and alpine discoveries.

Kufstein Fortress, the famous Roemerhofgasse, and the Kaiser mountains are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Goldener Loewen in Kufstein offers heritage hospitality right at the gateway to the historic Old Town.
